en.title: A.P.I.C
en.decryption: A-Agriculture becoming primary; P-Ploughshare (Phala) introduction; I-Iron (Shyama Ayas) revolution; C-Cities/Urbanization incipient stages.

hi.title: A.P.I.C
hi.decryption: A-Agriculture becoming primary; P-Ploughshare (Phala) introduction; I-Iron (Shyama Ayas) revolution; C-Cities/Urbanization incipient stages.

fact.en: Do not assume money-based trade existed; barter was still the primary mode of exchange.
fact.hi: Do not assume money-based trade existed; barter was still the primary mode of exchange.

fact.en: Do not confuse 'Shyama Ayas' (Iron) with copper/bronze; its use in agriculture triggered the second urbanization.
fact.hi: Do not confuse 'Shyama Ayas' (Iron) with copper/bronze; its use in agriculture triggered the second urbanization.

fact.en: The king did not own all land; private ownership emerged but was mediated by clan rights.
fact.hi: The king did not own all land; private ownership emerged but was mediated by clan rights.
